display.message: Hi Fixture Learner. We will work through two ideas: how the cell makes ATP, and the electron transport chain that supports it. Questions start easy and climb toward each idea target level, one at a time. Commands: next, skip, hint, why, more, ask: <your question>, summary, stop. Hints and second chances are part of learning, so use them.
display.example: Example (format only): Which organelle stores genetic material? A) mitochondrion B) nucleus C) ribosome D) vacuole.
display.question: Where in the cell is most ATP produced?
